title: Show an item's history from git: tadu show --history
notes: Both formats. Format 1 follows an item by its text through TODO.md, TODO_LOG.md and docs/todo-log/YYYY.md (git log -S per change); format 2 follows a task file through open/, closed/ and archive/YYYY[/MM]/ (one git log over its possible paths) and continues before tadu migrate with its Markdown item.
Supersedes the cancelled t-b56523ee: git log --follow loses a task file whose close turns the move into a delete plus an add.
result: tadu show --history for both formats, with archived years, migrate's archived years and the MCP show tool's history flag
evidence: pytest: 1208 tests at 100% coverage, among them tests/test_show_history.py, test_task_history.py, test_migration_history.py and test_markdown_history.py; timings in this change's review: 0.35-0.82 s for --history on the test repositories
